text: OVERDOSAGE If treatment dose is swallowed (or less than 100 mg of Fluoride ion) administer milk, limewater, or calcium-type antacid. In case of larger doses swallowed (more than 100 mg of Fluoride ion) administer ipecac syrup emetic and immediately seek medical help. Overdose symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain.
